title: SyntheaScript
summary: A small Python script that loads a preprocessed CSV of patient-like tabular data and uses it to train a generative model for producing synthetic records. It imports CTGAN directly from the standalone ctgan package to generate synthetic tabular data.
evidence: main.py:3 'from ctgan import CTGAN'; requirements.txt lists sdv
